source_method: Six authored native districts: three reviewed v2 plates plus three separately generated portrait source plates, downsampled and center-cropped without enlargement. Deterministic pairwise connector finishing closes the six-district ring.

chunks.role: switchback cliff road and reinforced seawall
flooded polders, sluices and radar foundations
naval tunnel approaches and segmented breakwaters

rules: Macro geography repeats only after six distinct 1024px districts.
Animated sea, surf, weather and destructible targets remain separate transparent or material planes.
Every adjacent pair, including final-to-first, has an exact zero-error boundary scanline.
World distance is integrated once; changing craft speed cannot re-phase elapsed scenery.
